generator.gps_geometry: linear interpolation between trip start and end coordinates
generator.fuel: deterministic consumption proportional to interpolated travel distance plus scripted idle/theft scenarios
generator.speed: computed from successive generated coordinates and elapsed seconds

pipeline.stage_to_nds: parse and validate simulated telemetry JSONL; recompute Haversine derived speed and isolate GPS jumps

interpretation: GPS position interpolation is straight line, not a navigable road route.
Low-speed density cells arise from scripted simulation and cannot evidence real traffic congestion.
Sensor curves are deterministic modeled signals, not physically validated IoT measurements.
FUEL_RECEIPT_MISMATCH is an injected label, not full invoice reconciliation.
Removed GPS jump points still appear in generator anomaly events but not the final DDS GPS table.
GPS synthetic provenance is an established source property, not a guess based on chart appearance.
